sourceChecks.text: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。
